title: ChallengeRequest
description: What the challenger is given: the requirements, the design or both designs, where they differ, and the practices held by design; on a second reading, what the designer now answers.

file.description: The requirements file, relative to the project, as requirements.check named it.

requirements.description: The requirements file whole, as requirements.check accepted it.

items.description: A design, as schemas/design.json gives it.

designs.description: The design, or the first and the second written apart, in that order.

differences.description: Where the two designs differ, one line each, worked out by script; empty with one design.

practices.description: The practices held by design, from the practices files, each its id and its words.

id.description: The practice's id, such as P-35.

answer.description: Whether the design holds the practice.

sentence.description: Why, in one sentence; for not-held, where the design breaks it.

practices.description: The first challenge's answers of not-held, each with its sentence.

wrong.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.

where.description: Where in the design: a module, an interface, an action or an example, by name.

fix.description: What would fix it, in one sentence.

answered.description: Only on a second reading: what the first challenge answered not held and found, which the one design given now answers.
